title: Classify each budget line as tracked or by-hand
description: Derive the mode from the pull recipe and render the matching tag.
acceptanceCriteria: A line with a non-empty pullRecipe renders the Synced tag.
No SYNCED_LINE_IDS list and no per-line boolean flag are introduced; the recipe field is the only signal.
rationale: One vertical slice: the mode a line is in decides everything else on the row.
